address: 20-22 Marlborough Place, Brighton and Hove, BN1 1UB, United Kingdom
bio: A contemporary transformation of a former bank, with a smart pavement terrace and a large black and gold clock adorning its outside wall. Ingredient-led Italian cooking is packed with flavour and accompanied by an Italian-focused wine list. Start with some snacks before moving on to pasta; or if there’s two or more of you, go for the sharing menu. Friendly, knowledgeable service completes the picture....
